item.title: New Zealand sanctions North Korean military firms, targeting support for Russia
item.description: New Zealand has slapped new sanctions on two North Korean military firms, part of a broader effort alongside allies to stem support for Russia’s military on the fourth anniversary of the Ukraine war.
